name: First Love
overview: The Bible teaches that our first love must be Jesus Christ, loving Him with all our heart, soul, and mind as the greatest commandment (Matthew 22:37). God's love is demonstrated supremely in giving His Son for our salvation (John 3:16), and Jesus calls us to love others as He has loved us, even to the point of laying down His life (John 15:12-13). Yet, Revelation 2:4 warns believers against abandoning this first love, emphasizing the necessity of maintaining a steadfast devotion to Christ above all else.
